config.description: Aspirine's Food subsystem (full-parity R1) — a PURE FLAT-STAT additive layer (CalcObjectFood, raw/.../classes/CalcObject/Food.js:43-75): 3 slots {Attack,Defence,Potion}, 43 items, NO conditions/postEffects/settings. A selected food's getStats(tier) (DbObjectFood.getStats, Food.js:96-109 → StatTable.getValue, StatTable.js:11-20: 1-indexed quality TIER, clamp-to-last, 0-floor, `if (value)` skip) is concat'd into the bag in CalcSet.getBaseStats; processPercent then folds percent keys /100. Driven via build.setFood(type, item, tier) (CalcSet.js:181) on the no-teammate passthrough (bol-stat's axis). 3 reps, each value-checking on DAMAGE triples: food-attack-keqing setFood('Attack', AdeptusTemptation, 3) → atk+372 + crit_rate+12 lifts every Keqing damage triple (base + crit); food-potion-diluc setFood('Potion', FlamingEssentialOil, 1) → dmg_pyro+25 lifts Diluc's pyro skill/burst (DMG_BONUS_ELEMENT_KEYS → fraction; one element proves all 7 oils); food-defence-albedo setFood('Defence', CallaLilySeafoodSoup, 4) → def+282 lifts Albedo's DEF-scaled skill.albedo_blossom + burst.albedo_fatal_blossom (his ATK normals untouched → the DEF lane is the RED→GREEN driver). Food keys are Aspirine-native (dmg_phys/hp_percent/crit_rate, NOT GOOD) → ALL already emitted by buildStats's read loop, so the ONLY hole is the missing bag concat: foodBurndown burns the reps RED until buildStats merges input.food (Task B). _manifest.json records {type,key,tier} so the burndown reconstructs the flat stats from generated/foodTables.ts (no raw import).
